name: Carpet Spot Extractor
definition: A portable commercial spray-extraction machine intended for localised carpet, stair, upholstery or vehicle-interior cleaning by applying solution through a hand or small floor tool and recovering the liquid into a separate tank.
includedScope: Portable commercial carpet and upholstery spotters
Compact spray extractors supplied with hand or small floor tools
excludedScope: Textiles not approved by their manufacturer
headline: Carpet spot extractor tanks, spray systems, recovery performance and buyer checks
description: This technical profile defines commercial portable spot extractors and explains solution delivery, recovery, tanks, tools, textile boundaries, representative models and procurement verification.
metaDescription: Commercial carpet spot extractor guide covering portable spotters, tanks, spray pressure, vacuum recovery, tools, representative models and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not model-specific purchasing, safety, hazardous-material, textile-care or repair advice. Confirm the current manual, exact configuration, serial range, local compliance and service terms before procurement or use.
